text: {"fixes":[{"element_id":"s14.e52","problem":"On s14 the character description text box is 8.7px too short (128.7 vs 137.1). This is the only data-el miss. The text is clipped or its line height is too tight.","fix":"Set the box to x24, y539.4, w168.8, h137.1. Use line-height about 17.1px so the 8 lines of text fill 137px, matching the real card."},{"element_id":"s02","problem":"The card cover images are flat placeholder art. The real screen shows a detailed painted fantasy town on the left card and a night city skyline on the right. This is the main red area on the heatmap.","fix":"Replace each cover with a photo-like fill: warm colorful market town tones (#c98a4a, #4a8fb0, #6a3a5a) on the left card, and dark blue-black with small window lights (#0b1220 with #d9a441 dots) on the right card. Keep the covers at y332-512 in the card. The pictures listed for s02 are only the filter icons, so no cover image can be requested."},{"element_id":"s02","problem":"The bottom nav center icon is a cat-face glyph. The real one is a swirl or spiral logo. The emoji on the tag chips (Male, Dominant, Female, Fictional, Anime) also differ and are drawn smaller.","fix":"Draw the center icon as a 28px spiral or circle-swirl outline in #cfcfe0 (a CSS or SVG spiral), not a cat. Use colorful emoji glyphs at 14px for the chip icons: 👨 ⛓ 👩‍🦰 📚 📺."},{"element_id":"s07","problem":"The avatar is a plain blue radial-glow gradient. The real avatar is a dark blue-teal alley scene. The Hot Day card image also differs in shape and shows a different crop of the character. No listed pictures exist for s07.","fix":"Restyle the avatar (x28,y75,w120,h120) as a dark teal-blue vertical gradient (#0e2a3f to #4a86b0 in the middle to #10202e) with some vertical dark bars. Shift the Hot Day character image so the white hair spikes sit at the top and the face lies lower, as in the real screen."},{"element_id":"s07","problem":"The FOLLOW and share buttons look different. The share button is a bright flat orange-yellow, but the real one is a darker gold gradient (#c9a227 to #8a6a10) with a light border. The FOLLOW border and text are dimmer than the real ones.","fix":"Give share a gradient of #e0b93a to #a67c12, white text and a 1px #f0d060 border. Make FOLLOW text and border #d9a92a."},{"element_id":"s05","problem":"The avatar shows a cartoon bucket on a dark tile. The real one is a shiba inu head in a teal bucket with a mop. The text runs slightly wide: 'No characters found' is bigger and the tab icons are offset.","fix":"Add a tan and white dog head at the top of the bucket in the avatar, and put a light mop handle on the left. Reduce the 'No characters found' font size to 16px, weight 600. Move the tab icons about 1px up."},{"element_id":"s14","problem":"The heading and option labels sit about 1px higher than on the real screen, and the mock text is bolder. The Sort by labels and Messages/Tokens labels are heavier.","fix":"Move the text blocks down 1px. Use font-weight 500 for the section labels (Sort by, Messages, Tokens, Proxy) and for the 'Filters' title."}],"summary":"The mock is layout-accurate: nearly every data-el is within 4px, and taps and contracts are clean. The remaining loss is visual fidelity, mainly the placeholder card covers on s02, the avatars on s05 and s07, and the nav icon. This round should fix the one s14.e52 height miss and bring imagery colors and text weights closer to the real screens."}
